ten_arm.cells: polten_<model> of every run (or of the selected run, see runs_per_size), size and combination

selected.rule: arm_registry.select_seed over the exact-mask runs of the released recipe: the lowest validation score of the kept checkpoint, ties to the lower seed

ten_arm.schedules_1_to_9: one complete schedule sampled from the policy's action distribution under the exact mask per seed, p97_policy_anytime.PolicyRoller.rollout_batch with a batch of one
ten_arm.stream: torch.manual_seed(SeedSequence([20261113, 2, size code, instance index, combination index, training seed, k]).generate_state(1, uint64) // 2), k = 1..9

quantities.randbest: best of the ten policy schedules against the best of the ten random rollouts
quantities.rule: best of the ten policy schedules against the best classical rule
quantities.rule7: best of the ten policy schedules against the best of the seven rules
quantities.greedy_rand: greedy schedule of the policy against the mean of the ten random rollouts
quantities.samp_rand: mean of the nine sampled policy schedules against the mean of the ten random rollouts

ten_arm.per_run: mean over instances and the 95% bootstrap of the other gaps (20000 resamples, fresh default_rng(7))
ten_arm.pooled: at a size that holds every run: crossed hierarchical bootstrap over runs and instances, stats_family.hier_boot (20000 resamples, fresh default_rng(11)); seed-level t interval as t_lo, t_hi; no pooled row at a size that holds the selected run only
ten_arm.sign: 100 (policy - reference) / reference; negative means the policy is shorter
